sn22.152:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn22.152:1.3: So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || 4
sn22.152:1.5: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ ditthi uppajjati ||

sn22.152:1.11: So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammoti || || 10
